chapter: Lu Barker and the Barbarin family
title: Lu's daughter Sylvia Barker and grandchildren
summary: Lu names her daughter Sylvia, her two husbands, and grandson Larry and his son.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: I'll be darned. That is beautiful. And you've got one daughter.
Well, she had two husbands. Her first husband was Rene Browner(?), and he passed away. She had one son for him, Larry Browner. And Larry has a little boy, Christopher, and now got one on the way.
Is that so?! I didn't know that. That's great.
Uh-huh. And years ago, she married Leonard Jones. Leonard Jones is her new husband.
